champion.builds: THE BEST BRIAR BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Briar Top build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Press the Attack as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Sudden Impact and Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Black Cleaver. For your last 3 items, you should build Death's Dance, Spirit Visage and finish with Sundered Sky. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - Q - E. Right now, this build has 52.9% winrate over 514 matches played. Optional Your second option for Briar Top build would be to take Teleport and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Press the Attack as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Overgrowth with Second Wind in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Black Cleaver, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Overlord's Bloodmail as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Death's Dance, Spirit Visage and Sterak's Gage. The skill order for this build is W - Q - E. In the current patch, this build has a 41.7% win rate over 84 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Conditioning with Overgrowth in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Black Cleaver as a third item. You want to finish the build with Death's Dance, Spirit Visage and Jak'Sho, The Protean. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - Q - E. This build is currently sitting at a 50.0% win rate across 78 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Briar Top build in the current patch, try Teleport and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Lethal Tempo, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Second Wind with Revitalize as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Black Cleaver as third item. The last 3 options are Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage and Sundered Sky. The ability order for this build is W - Q - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 60.0% win rate over 70 matches played. Situational Briar Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Briar build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Briar runes page.
